resources.string: Keeps the brightness wheel and the camera button working inside sideloaded apps. It reads no screen content — only which app is in front, so the mapping can differ per app.

Reads the six-digit code off the system pairing dialog during setup, so pairing needs no computer. It can only ever see the Settings app, and only for ninety seconds after you tap Pair automatically. Turn it off once setup is done.

The keyboard-replace prototype. Only inside LightOS apps, and only when you switch it on, it reads which field is focused so it can put its own keyboard over the built-in one and type into the field. LightOS apps only; everything stays on the phone.
